item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"This behavior is a real limitation of the current `TwoStepAdapter`, not just an inspection mistake: the implementation explicitly notes that the second step is created on the fly and cannot be learned or optimized from demonstrations.","span_ids":["e1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The first-stage prompt to the main LM still uses the original task and includes any demos passed into the adapter before adding the current user input.","span_ids":["e2"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The extraction step does not use those demos: `parse()` creates a new `ChatAdapter` call with `demos=[]` and passes only the main model's completion as `{\"text\": completion}`.","span_ids":["e3"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"The extraction prompt is built from a fresh signature whose only input is `text`, plus the original output fields, so it is not reusing the original input-side task signature.","span_ids":["e4"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The test confirms the extractor LM receives a separate two-message prompt whose system message lists `text` and the output fields, and whose user message contains the main LM's raw text output.","span_ids":["e5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/adapters/two_step_adapter.py","start_line":13,"end_line":18},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/adapters/two_step_adapter.py","start_line":48,"end_line":75},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/adapters/two_step_adapter.py","start_line":77,"end_line":100},{"span_id":"e4","path":"dspy/adapters/two_step_adapter.py","start_line":207,"end_line":229},{"span_id":"e5","path":"tests/adapters/test_two_step_adapter.py","start_line":55,"end_line":70}]}
